info.name: Stripe Payout Flow (Fleet VA Top-Up)
info.description:
Payout where Fleet VA (connected account) has insufficient EUR balance to cover the payout amount. The platform tops up the transfer to cover the shortfall. Asserts payout_order created with non-FAILED status and merchant_top_up_amount IS NOT NULL (top-up was recorded).

Mock setup: Fleet VA balance = 50 cents EUR (far below any ride fare). Platform balance = 100,000 cents EUR (sufficient for adjusted transfer). Requires mock server to support `header.Stripe-Account` extraction to route fleet-VA and platform balance calls to different responses.

item.name: Enable Instant Payout Without Redeemable Cutoff (BPP)

exec: pm.test('Instant payout enabled with no redeemable cutoff', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });
pm.test('Wallet payout is enabled for the city', function () { pm.expect(d.enableWalletPayout).to.eql(true); });
pm.test('Instant transfer out is enabled', function () { pm.expect(d.instantTransferOutEnabled).to.eql(true); });
pm.test('No redeemable cutoff, so all settled earnings are withdrawable', function () { pm.expect(d.redeemableCutoffDays === null || d.redeemableCutoffDays === undefined).to.eql(true); });
var withdrawable = Number(d.withdrawableBalance === null || d.withdrawableBalance === undefined ? 0 : d.withdrawableBalance);
console.log('Wallet before payout: current', d.currentBalance, 'withdrawable', d.withdrawableBalance);
pm.test('Whole wallet balance is withdrawable once the cutoff is removed', function () { pm.expect(withdrawable).to.be.closeTo(Number(d.currentBalance), 0.011); });
pm.test('There is money to withdraw', function () { pm.expect(withdrawable).to.be.above(0); });
pm.test('Payout triggered (200)', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); }); console.log('Payout triggered — Fleet VA shortfall should cause top-up from platform.');
pm.test('Instant payout recorded for the driver', function () { pm.expect(latest).to.be.an('object'); pm.expect(latest.payoutType).to.equal('INSTANT'); });

pm.test('Payout amount is the withdrawable balance (fee included or deducted)', function () { var a = Number(latest.amount || 0), fee = Number(latest.payoutFee || 0); pm.expect(Math.min(Math.abs(a - expected), Math.abs(a + fee - expected))).to.be.below(0.011); });

pm.test('Merchant top-up covers the connected account shortfall', function () { var t = Number(latest.merchantTopUpAmount); pm.expect(t).to.be.above(0); pm.expect(t).to.be.at.most(Number(latest.amount) + 0.011); });

pm.test('Nothing left to withdraw after the instant payout', function () { pm.expect(Number(d.withdrawableBalance || 0)).to.be.closeTo(0, 0.011); });
